Install disktree on Omarchy

Disk space treemap for Omarchy: see what fills a disk by kind, mark what should go, and remove it

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add disktree-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.11.0-3:
    pacman -Qi disktree-bin

Open and use disktree

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql disktree-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install disktree on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add disktree-bin. The download is 11.4 MB and it takes 29 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is disktree free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall disktree?

Run omarchy pkg drop disktree-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does disktree depend on?

The package declares 8 dependencies: glibc, libgcc, libxcb, libxkbcommon, libxkbcommon-x11, wayland, libglvnd, vulkan-icd-loader. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is disktree in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as disktree-bin (version 0.11.0-3) in the official Omarchy package repository. Tobias Lütke makes it. Project site: https://github.com/tobi/disktree. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
